Natural Polyphenol Pentagalloyl Glucose as a Potent Xanthine Oxidase Inhibitor for Hyperuricemia Treatment. Hyperuricemia (HUA) is a metabolic disorder characterized by increased serum uric acid (UA) levels. Here, we showed that pentagalloyl glucose (PGG), a well-known natural polyphenol, significantly decreased UA levels both in potassium oxonate/hypoxanthine-induced HUA mice and adenosine-induced hepatocytes.
